The Senan ritual

Two minutes. Twice a day. Every day.

1

Squeeze

A ribbon on your brush is all you need. For children under 6, use a pea-sized amount and supervise brushing.

2

Brush with intention

Brush thoroughly after meals or at least twice daily, or as directed by your dentist.

3

Spit, don't rinse

For best results, skip the rinse. The formula works with contact time on your enamel.

Ingredients

Sorbitol, Aqua, Hydrated Silica, Xylitol, Glycerin, Hydroxyapatite (Nano), Salvadora Persica Root Extract, Coco-Glucoside, Cellulose Gum, Mentha Piperita (Peppermint) Oil, Menthol, Xanthan Gum, Stevia Rebaudiana Leaf Powder, Mica, Sodium Benzoate, Tocopherol, Cyanocobalamin, Titanium Dioxide, Iron Oxide.

Is it suitable for children?

For children under 6 years, use a pea-sized amount and supervise brushing. Avoid swallowing, and don't use it if you're allergic to any of the listed ingredients.

What does it taste like?

A naturally refreshing, miswak-infused mint made with peppermint oil and menthol, sweetened with stevia and xylitol.
